Members and roles

ToOp, on the communityArgsWho
Give a rolebase.setRolemember (key), role: admin · member · viewer · guestowner
Take it awaybase.clearRolemember. They stay a member.owner
Give a titlegroup.setOfficeoffice (free text), holder, status: pending · accepted, at (ms)owner
Vacate a titlegroup.clearOfficeofficeowner

A role applies only to someone already on the roster. A title grants nothing. Show a button only to someone who may press it: the owner is the object's owner, admins are in roles.

To list the members, with what each says about themselves, their answers, and the community's questions, read GET /v2/members.

Becoming a member

Your site's session reaches the community only when the person signed in is one of its members; for anyone else, /v2/graph has no community, and the starter says so. A person joins with a claim from your community's QR code: POST /v2/join, from your site's own session. Adding and removing members by hand, and invitations, are done in WallFlowers: a site's session is refused on /v2/add. In WallFlowers, the owner adds a teammate by their contact code: see Teams: adding a teammate.

Order people as WallFlowers does: the owner, then admins, then everyone else.
